note.he: מערבב/ת סוגי תנאי (if + הווה עם would, או if + עבר עם will)
note.en: Mixes conditional types (if + present with would, if + past with will)

tip.he: שני החלקים צריכים להתאים: if + הווה → will. if + עבר → would. if + had + V3 → would have + V3.
tip.en: Match the two parts: if + present → will; if + past → would; if + had + V3 → would have + V3.

note.he: משתמש/ת ב־wish + would על עצמו/ה (I wish I would have)
note.en: Uses wish + would about oneself (I wish I would have)

tip.he: wish + would רק כשרוצים שמישהו אחר או משהו אחר ישתנה. על עצמי: I wish I had / could.
tip.en: wish + would is for other people or things changing. About yourself: I wish I had / could.

note.he: משתמש/ת ב־wish לאיחול אמיתי לעתיד במקום hope
note.en: Uses wish for a real hope about the future instead of hope

tip.he: משהו אפשרי: hope + הווה (I hope you win). משהו לא מציאותי: wish + עבר (I wish I were taller).
tip.en: Possible: hope + present. Unreal: wish + past.

tip.he: must = בטוח שכן. can't = בטוח שלא. might / may / could = אולי.
tip.en: must = sure it's true; can't = sure it isn't; might / may / could = maybe.

note.he: חוזר/ת על השם או בוחר/ת כינוי לא נכון ב־tag (isn't this, doesn't Maya)
note.en: Repeats the noun or uses the wrong pronoun in the tag (isn't this, doesn't Maya)

tip.he: ב־tag תמיד כינוי גוף: Maya → she, this → it, There is → isn't there.
tip.en: The tag always uses a pronoun: Maya → she, this → it, There is → isn't there.

note.he: משאיר/ה מילות זמן כמו tomorrow ו־tonight בדיווח על העבר
note.en: Keeps time words like tomorrow and tonight when reporting the past

tip.he: tomorrow → the next day, tonight → that night, yesterday → the day before.
tip.en: tomorrow → the next day, tonight → that night, yesterday → the day before.

note.he: מדווח/ת ציווי בלי to (told us don't, asked us close)
note.en: Reports a command without to (told us don't, asked us close)

tip.he: ציווי ובקשה: told / asked + מישהו + (not) to + פועל.
tip.en: Commands and requests: told / asked + person + (not) to + verb.
